name: Philippines
prevalence_note: Philippines 2025-2026 warnings: bank Account and Credit Card OTP Vishing; fake Telecom Regulator and SIM Deactivation Vishing; part-Time Online Task and Advance Deposit Scam.
cross_border_note: Calls in English or Tagalog, often with texts sent first.

scams.name: Bank Verification and Credit Card Upgrade OTP Vishing
scams.name_en: Bank Account and Credit Card OTP Vishing
scams.signals_en: Callers address the recipient by name while posing as bank fraud officers or credit card agents offering a free limit upgrade, points conversion, or urgent account verification.
scams.legit_en: Philippine banks and the central bank remind consumers that official representatives never send clickable text links and never ask customers for passwords, card security numbers, or one-time PINs during phone calls.
bait_tactics: Hold on for a second, the electric fan right beside me is pretty loud so I missed that part, could you repeat which department you're calling from?
Wait a bit, I left my reading glasses in the bedroom so I can't read any small messages on my phone screen right now.
Our home internet has been super slow since this morning, could you spell out the reference code again while I look for a notepad?

scams.name: Fake Telecommunications Regulator SIM Suspension Call
scams.name_en: Fake Telecom Regulator and SIM Deactivation Vishing
scams.signals_en: Callers impersonate telecommunications commission personnel or mobile network compliance staff, alleging that the subscriber's registered SIM card was flagged for irregular activity and faces immediate deactivation.
scams.legit_en: The National Telecommunications Commission and Philippine mobile carriers never call individual subscribers to demand money, settle regulatory violations over the phone, or request personal banking details to prevent SIM deactivation.
bait_tactics: Oh really, let me think which ID card was used when this SIM was registered, could you repeat the reference details slowly?
Give me a moment please, someone is knocking at the front gate for water delivery, go ahead and explain the notice again.
The signal indoors keeps cutting out every few seconds, could you repeat your office division name one more time?

scams.name: Online Task and Commission Deposit Recruitment Scam
scams.name_en: Part-Time Online Task and Advance Deposit Scam
scams.signals_en: Callers follow up on unsolicited recruitment messages promising easy daily income for completing simple online product-rating or e-commerce tasks.
scams.legit_en: Legitimate Philippine employers and licensed e-commerce platforms never cold-call applicants to offer paid clicking tasks or require workers to deposit personal money into external accounts before releasing earned compensation or commissions.
bait_tactics: Wait, I'm not very familiar with how online merchant tasks work, could you walk me through how the organization is registered first?
Hold on a bit, my phone battery is almost drained and I can't find my charger cable, could you explain the schedule again?
Sorry, the rain on the roof just got really loud here, could you repeat what kind of work contract comes with that?
